race.title: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Veterans' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: CHARLES RITZ has a patchy profile but his record fresh is hard to fault so he could be the answer in a trappy-looking contest. Last year's winner Fern Hill shaped as if needing his comeback run despite his prominence in the market so is next best. CHARLES RITZ FERN HILL (IRE) SHERBORNE (IRE)
